query:
When the family sorted contributions for the January gathering, everyone agreed to bring something. What did one person's initial response reveal about their actual relationship to the food-bringing expectation, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Nkem
B. Emeka
C. Bisi
D. Kayode
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:48:00) Kayode everyone brings something to eat. Drinks is not enough. What will you cook?
[2] (about=Funke, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:50:00) Adaeze I know you feel strongly about everyone contributing a dish - and you are absolutely right - but maybe Kayode can bring drinks AND the puff puff? That way we are covered 😂
[3] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:57:00) ADAEZE I will bring ofe akwu as I did last time. KAYODE, puff puff is not a dish. Best regards, Dele
[4] (about=Nkem, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T19:06:00) I think I can bring something small - I may be wrong but I recall Adaeze mentioning she liked the mosa I made before. Would that be welcome, I wonder?
[5] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T19:08:00) Nkem that is perfect. Bring the mosa. My children this gathering will be wonderful. God willing.
[6] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:59:00) My dear I will make moin moin on the day. And Kayode please make sure you eat something proper before you arrive 🙏
[7] (about=Bisi, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:41:00) omg yes SEUN's jollof 🙌🙌🙌 what do I bring
[8] (about=Kayode, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:14:00) Knew this was coming lol. Still making jollof for the family though right?
[9] (about=Tolu, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:11:00) No complaints about the food. Just to note though - did anyone else notice Dad missed church this morning?
[10] (about=Tolu, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:50:00) Just to note, this is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
[11] (about=Adaeze, core, t1 @2025-01-13T18:30:00) wants everyone to be at her house on Saturday 25th January
[12] (about=Emeka, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:56:00) Good rice is good rice. E.
[13] (about=Kayode, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:44:00) Can do drinks? Easier for me to sort drinks than food?
[14] (about=Nkem, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:50:00) I think this is lovely. I have been thinking - I may be wrong but I would like to learn to make one Adaeze dish properly before Christmas. Would that be appropriate to ask?
[15] (about=Seun, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:45:00) mum I will eat double portions honestly thank you I mean this is all I needed to hear
[16] (about=Tolu, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T20:15:00) Clinically speaking, restaurant reservations made in October for February the 14th are the only responsible choice.
[17] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T20:23:00) TOLU I see the reasoning. A unified gathering has its merits. I will attend regardless. Regards, D.A.O.

query:
The family had their regular Sunday video call. What did one family member's participation reveal about their actual relationship to the call — and what in Adaeze's account of the call makes that visible?

Options:
A. Kayode
B. Bisi
C. Emeka
D. Nkem
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Good evening my children. Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.
[2] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T20:08:00) Nkem you are family. Anyone who loves each other enough to come despite finding it difficult - that is what counts. God willing you will feel more at home each time.
[3] (about=Nkem, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:48:00) I think Kayode has been making a real effort recently - I may be wrong but I notice the same. Also I had a lovely time at the January gathering. I perhaps found it a little full-on at first but once the mosa was gone it got much easier.
[4] (about=Kayode, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:50:00) What she said lol. Also Nkem found the whole thing a bit overwhelming but she will never admit it?
[5] (about=Bisi, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T20:24:00) omg Kayode 🥺🥺 Nkem you better be impressed
[6] (about=Seun, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:35:00) honestly mum I noticed too I mean this is a new era, the Kayode era of actually showing up lol
[7] (about=Tolu, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:41:00) Good. Just to note, consistency is the only thing the family chat actually requires.
[8] (about=Emeka, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T20:06:00) She came. That is what matters. E.
[9] (about=Emeka, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:38:00) It is not a pattern. E.
[10] (about=Emeka, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:18:00) Tired. E.
[11] (about=Adaeze, core, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Good evening my children. Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.
[12] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:41:00) My dear Emeka, please listen to Tolu. I see too many patients who push through when they should be resting 🙏 a missed Sunday is fine, just rest
[13] (about=Nkem, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:23:00) Kayode, I am very glad you shared this here. I think the family should hear it. I may be wrong but I believe this is the most important professional news in the group for some time - would that be fair to say, Adaeze?
[14] (about=Seun, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:57:00) Nkem I love that you said that honestly I mean you are allowed to find it a lot, no one expects you to perform being fine with ten people in one room
[15] (about=Tolu, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:50:00) Just to note, this is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
[16] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T20:05:00) ADAEZE correct. Christmas is at the family home. No variations required. Best regards, Dele
